description: White flash with black bars, block glitch settling into the wordmark loud>society on black (glow, RGB split), optional country suffix revealed in steps (inline 16:9, second line 9:16), micro glitch; sound: noise hit + shouted voice tag (2–5 s).

parameters.suffix: Country suffix of the wordmark (brazil, indonesia, colombia; others: build-logo.mjs --suffix) or empty
parameters.voiceTag: Voice tag asset id (default voice-shout-guy) or null for none
parameters.noiseHit: Noise hit asset id (default noise-hit-c) or null for none
